mechanics.claim: Basic attacks generate a stack of Clockwork Winding, refreshing the duration on subsequent attacks and capping at 2 stacks; all stacks are lost when Orianna attacks a different enemy.
mechanics.quote: '''Orianna's''' basic attacks generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Clockwork Winding'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 2 times. All stacks are lost when attacking a new enemy.

mechanics.claim: The on-hit bonus magic damage from Clockwork Winding does not apply against structures.
mechanics.quote: The attacks do not deal the '''bonus''' damage against {{tip|structures}}.

mechanics.claim: Casting any ability puts a brief 0.01-second global cooldown on all of Orianna's other abilities.
mechanics.quote: ''The Ball'' incurs a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.01}}-second}} global cooldown on all of her abilities when she casts any ability.

mechanics.claim: When the Ball snaps back to Orianna it puts a 0.75-second cooldown on Command: Shockwave.
mechanics.quote: ''The Ball''... snaps back to her if she moves too far away from it, which incurs a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.75}}-second}} cooldown on ''{{ai|Command: Shockwave|Orianna}}''.

mechanics.claim: Runaan's Hurricane's extra bolts reset Clockwork Winding's stacks because they count as hitting a different target on-hit.
mechanics.quote: {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} extra bolts will cause ''Clockwork Winding'' to reset its stacks, as she hits targets other than her latest one {{tip|on-hit}}.
